verification.notes: Confirmed via independent searches: FR-V 4285x1810x1610, WB 2685, trunk 439/1049/1600 (ADAC, both pre-facelift and facelift; AutoScout24 lists 1625 mm height for some diesel, ADAC says 1610 - not changed). Stream facelift 4575x1695x1590, WB 2725 (ADAC; pre-facelift 4570/2720), trunk 158/435/718 confirmed by km77 (435 l with 3rd row folded, 718 l all folded to window line; 1349 l to roof per km77) and AutoScout24 158-718 l. S2000 4135x1750x1285, WB 2400, 143 l (ams, encycarpedia). NSX NA2 4425x1810x1170, 154 l (mobile.md, ultimatespecs, encycarpedia), sold until 08/05. NSX NC1 4487x1939x1204, WB 2630, 110 l (autoplenum, Top Gear, fastcarcheck; one AU source 1215 mm height), market launch 2016, production end 12/2022. Prelude 4525x1880x1349, WB 2604, 264/663/760 l, 184 PS (ADAC, AUTO BILD). Prelude yearFrom 2025 is slightly uncertain: Weser-Kurier says German launch 'zum Jahreswechsel' at 49,500 EUR, AutoScout24 says spring 2026, the only ADAC entry found is dated 'ab 03/26' (S+ Shift trim) - no clear contradiction, so not corrected; consider 2026 if German first registrations only started 2026. Unverified (not contradicted): FR-V/Stream per-variant power values, NSX-T trunk equality.
